conclusion: No demonstrated gather32 performance gain against warmed gather64. Keep stock compute and defaults unchanged. MTP acceptance is identical.

scope.quality: Exact-value retrieval graded; sampled code/review outputs ungraded. Replacement coding corpus, not unpublished author prompts.

definitions.three_turn_seconds: For each repetition sum TTFT + 1000 / calibrated decode_tps across its three turns, then average the two sums. Models 1000 output tokens per turn; not actual elapsed conversation time.
definitions.decode_tps: Output-token-weighted harmonic mean of calibrated native decode rates over all six turns. Native rates multiplied by measured guest-monotonic / guest-raw clock ratios.
definitions.prefill_tps: Arithmetic mean of calibrated native prefill rates for the two initial turns.
definitions.observed_wall_seconds: Sum of six independently measured client request wall times for actual output lengths; excludes startup, inter-request checks, process overhead, and cleanup.
definitions.cache: Initial cache_n=0 means cold KV/prompt cache, not a verified cold OS lookup-file cache. Follow-ups cache_n=32768.

equivalence.method: SHA-256 file bytes, canonical request JSON matching recorded hashes, UTF-8 content/reasoning digests, prompt/output token counts, message counts, finish/cache/draft counters by repetition/turn. No prompt/output text or token-file contents retained.

memory_scope.per_request: 0.2-second client host RAM/commit samples and retained controller snapshots; summary host_memory_floor_bytes takes per-request observed minima.
memory_scope.controller_full_run: Terminal controller minimum_available_gib, sampled every 0.5 seconds from engine start through readiness/requests/shutdown; full-run minimum commit headroom not retained.
memory_scope.native_startup_warning: Logs report 0.0 GiB left after loaded allocations. Retained Windows host telemetry reports over 24 GiB; native warning is guest startup text, not a measured Windows reserve minimum.

limitations: Only two repetitions per cell in fixed 64/32/64 order; no randomized or counterbalanced replication.

First64 initial lookup is 36.6 seconds; 32 and final64 first reads are both 10.4 seconds. Warmed final64 largely reproduces 32, consistent with OS lookup-file-cache/order confounding; no cache flush or disk-residency measurement.
Prompt/KV cache was cold at each initial turn, but OS file-cache coldness was not controlled.
No MTP depth sweep: manifests retain depth 2. Acceptance is 2094/2497=0.8386063275931117 in every cell. Greedy depth documentation does not establish a sampled depth or acceptance gain here.
Hash identity covers these 18 sampled requests only; not general sampled-distribution or coding-quality equivalence.

primary_documentation.claim: MTP_DEPTH is documented as consecutive draft depth for greedy requests.
Prompt lookup applies to greedy requests; sampled requests use the MTP head and adaptive acceptance policy.
